headlines.title_en: MOFCOM and 7 other departments: Support local governments in determining smart home product subsidy categories and subsidy standards
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce and seven other departments issued the Action Plan for Promoting Smart Home Consumption, which states that local governments will be supported in independently and reasonably determining subsidy categories and subsidy standards for smart home products based on local conditions, and in coordinating support for the purchase of new whole-home smart home systems. Financial institutions are encouraged to develop diversified consumer finance products and services around consumption needs such as home furnishing and home decoration. The fiscal interest subsidy policy for personal consumer loans should be well utilized to guide financial institutions in increasing loan support for smart home consumption and to actively support consumers in purchasing smart home-related products.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.
The reading beat a 3.6 per cent projection from economists polled by financial data provider Wind.

headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月份工厂出厂价格增速加快，而消费者通胀再次抬头，原因在于与美以对伊朗战争相关的能源和大宗商品成本波动。国家统计局周三发布的数据显示，上月生产者价格指数同比上涨3.8%，高于7月份的3.5%。

headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Composite Index opened lower and rebounded to gain 0.16%, with lab-grown diamond and pharmaceutical stocks strengthening collectively. Hong Kong stocks bottomed out and rebounded, with the Hang Seng Index up 0.35% at midday, the Hang Seng Tech Index up 0.17%, and the Hang Seng Biotech Index surging more than 3%. As AI development slowed and oil prices soared, Japanese and South Korean stock markets fell, with South Korea's KOSPI dropping more than 2%. The front-month crude oil futures contract on the Shanghai Futures Exchange rose more than 11% intraday, surpassing 900 yuan per barrel for the first time since listing. China's central bank conducted 504 billion yuan of overnight reverse repurchase operations in the open market. Securities Association of China: Step up internal inspections of key links in key businesses such as investment banking and bond trading; prohibit the use of algorithm design and other methods to convey or seek improper benefits. National Health Commission: Further foster a fertility-friendly environment.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Increase the supply of sci-tech credit products, support M&A and integration of sci-tech enterprises
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau issued opinions on advancing the improvement of quality and efficiency of sci-tech finance in Shanghai's banking and insurance sectors. Increase the supply of sci-tech credit products. Step up credit support for scientific and technological research and development and the commercialization of scientific and technological achievements, and provide differentiated support in terms of product limits, loan terms, pricing mechanisms, and guarantee methods. Banks may independently determine, based on their actual operations and management, the specific methods for calculating the working capital needs of sci-tech enterprises.

headlines.title: 国务院国资委：中央企业带头及时支付账款
headlines.summary: 国务院国资委财管运行局负责人裴仁佺14日在国新办举行的国务院政策例行吹风会上说，《关于加强中小企业回款难问题治理有关工作的通知》对央企发挥表率作用提出专门要求。接下来，中央企业将积极筹措资金，确保及时支付；今后更要把对中小企业现金支付作为一条“硬杠杠”坚持好，同时结合自身实际对大型企业保持合理现金支付比例，推动沿业务链条传导，并严格“票证”使用，严禁新开6个月以上“票证”；将督促央企带头遵守所在行业领域规定，率先在合同中明确四项关键要素，率先响应并践行行业及时支付倡议等。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council: Central enterprises should take the lead in paying accounts promptly
headlines.summary_en: Pei Renquan, head of the Finance and Operation Bureau of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, said on the 14th at a regular State Council policy briefing held by the State Council Information Office that the Notice on Strengthening the Governance of the Difficulty Small and Medium-sized Enterprises Face in Getting Paid sets specific requirements for central enterprises to play an exemplary role. Next, central enterprises will actively raise funds to ensure timely payment; going forward, they must treat cash payment to small and medium-sized enterprises as a "hard benchmark" and adhere to it, while maintaining a reasonable cash payment ratio for large enterprises based on their own actual circumstances, promoting transmission along the business chain, and strictly regulating the use of "bills and certificates," with a strict prohibition on newly issuing "bills and certificates" with maturities of more than 6 months; they will urge central enterprises to take the lead in complying with the regulations of their respective industries and fields, be the first to specify four key elements in contracts, and be the first to respond to and practice industry timely payment initiatives, among other things. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Guide insurance funds to increase capital contributions to Shanghai venture capital, equity, and M&A funds
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau issued opinions on promoting the improvement of quality and efficiency of technology finance in Shanghai's banking and insurance industries. It mentioned broadening corporate financing channels. It will advance the pilot reform of long-term investment by insurance funds, guide insurance funds to increase capital contributions to Shanghai venture capital, equity, and merger and acquisition funds, and support insurance institutions within its jurisdiction to establish private equity and securities investment funds, focusing on strategic emerging industries and hard technology sectors.

headlines.title_en: 8 departments: Guide financial institutions to increase loan support for smart home consumption and actively support consumers in purchasing smart home-related products
headlines.summary_en: [Eight departments: Guide financial institutions to increase loan support for smart home consumption and actively support consumers in purchasing smart home-related products] The Ministry of Commerce and seven other departments issued the Action Plan for Promoting Smart Home Consumption, which states that financial institutions are encouraged to develop diversified consumer finance products and services around consumption needs such as home furnishing and home decoration. The fiscal interest subsidy policy for personal consumer loans should be well utilized to guide financial institutions in increasing loan support for smart home consumption and to actively support consumers in purchasing smart home-related products.

headlines.title: 商务部消费促进司负责人解读《促进智能家居消费行动方案》
headlines.summary: 《行动方案》坚持目标导向、问题导向，针对智能家居消费的增长点及存在的堵点卡点，提出扩大优质智能家居供给、完善智能家居标准体系、优化社区便民服务等七条举措，重点突出以下四个方面：一是坚持供需协同发力。二是打造多元融合生态。三是精准服务不同群体。四是打通便民服务链条。下一步，商务部将会同相关部门落实落细各项工作举措，推动相关政策尽快落地见效，带动更多智能家居产品走入百姓家庭，更好满足人民美好生活需要。

headlines.title_en: Head of the Consumption Promotion Department of MOFCOM interprets the Action Plan for Promoting Smart Home Consumption
headlines.summary_en: The Action Plan adheres to a goal-oriented and problem-oriented approach, and in response to the growth points and existing bottlenecks and obstacles in smart home consumption, proposes seven measures including expanding the supply of high-quality smart homes, improving the smart home standards system, and optimizing community convenience services, with emphasis on the following four aspects: First, adhere to coordinated efforts on both the supply and demand sides. Second, create a diversified and integrated ecosystem. Third, provide precise services for different groups. Fourth, open up the convenience service chain. Next, the Ministry of Commerce will work with relevant departments to implement all work measures in detail, promote the early implementation and effectiveness of relevant policies, bring more smart home products into ordinary households, and better meet the people's needs for a better life.

Today's turnover was 1.64 trillion yuan, a shrinkage of 344 billion yuan from last Friday, setting a second-lowest single-day turnover record for the year. headlines.title: 上海：鼓励有条件的金融机构建设企业级人工智能平台

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Encourage qualified financial institutions to build enterprise-level artificial intelligence platforms
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau issued opinions on promoting the improvement of quality and efficiency of technology finance in Shanghai's banking and insurance industries. It will use digital and intelligent empowerment to enhance technology financial services. It will give play to the innovative empowering role of new technologies such as artificial intelligence in technology finance, encourage qualified financial institutions to build enterprise-level artificial intelligence platforms, and comprehensively use digital technologies such as big data, blockchain, the Internet of Things, and quantum computing to empower all aspects including product development, business decision-making, and risk management, improving the digital and intelligent operation level of technology finance.

headlines.title: 上海并购基金三期正式开始投资运作
headlines.summary: 9月14日，据国泰海通消息，上海并购私募投资基金三期合伙企业（有限合伙）（简称“上海并购基金三期”）已在中国证券投资基金业协会完成备案，正式开始投资运作。上海并购基金三期首关规模9亿元，由国泰海通私募子公司作为基金管理人，联合大型产业集团、上市公司、金融机构等共同发起设立，主要聚焦高端制造、集成电路、新材料、新能源、信息技术等国家政策支持产业的并购等股权投资机会。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai M&A Fund Phase III officially begins investment operations
headlines.summary_en: On September 14, according to Guotai Haitong, Shanghai Mergers and Acquisitions Private Equity Fund Phase III Partnership (Limited Partnership) (abbreviated as "Shanghai M&A Fund Phase III") has completed filing with the Asset Management Association of China and officially began investment operations. The first close of Shanghai M&A Fund Phase III was 900 million yuan, with Guotai Haitong's private equity subsidiary as the fund manager, jointly initiated and established with large industrial groups, listed companies, financial institutions, etc., mainly focusing on merger and acquisition and other equity investment opportunities in industries supported by national policies such as high-end manufacturing, integrated circuits, new materials, new energy, and information technology.

headlines.title_en: A-share closing review: ChiNext Index fell 1.1%, lab-grown diamond and MLCC sectors bucked the trend to rally
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 14 - Today the three major A-share indices maintained a volatile trend. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.07%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.64%, and the ChiNext Index fell 1.1%. Combined turnover in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was 1.63 trillion yuan, a decrease of 342.7 billion yuan from the previous trading day. In terms of market performance, more than 3,100 stocks across the market rose. The lab-grown diamond sector was strong all day, with Inno Laser up more than 15% and Huanghe Whirlwind hitting the daily limit up; the CRO sector was active, with Nearshore Protein and Wanbang Pharmaceutical hitting the 20% daily limit up; the MLCC concept strengthened against the trend, with Shuangxing New Materials and others hitting the daily limit up; the data security concept moved higher, with Bohui Technology and Yongxin Tocean hitting the 20% daily limit up. In addition, the PCB concept, minor metals concept, consumer electronics, and automobile whole vehicles sectors were among the top gainers; the grain concept, tourism concept, coal, livestock farming, and national defense and military industry sectors were among the top decliners.
